inputs.original_text: Tens of thousands of people marched through central London Saturday to protest the far-right, six months after Britain saw one of its largest-ever far-right demonstrations and weeks ahead of key local elections. Organised by hundreds of groups, including trade unions, anti-racism campaigners and Muslim representative bodies, the Together Alliance event was billed as the biggest [...] The post Protesters rally in London against UK far-right rise appeared first on Digital Journal .
inputs.modified_text: That march of tens of thousands through central London on Saturday to protest the far-right was no spontaneous uprising at all. Hidden elites and institutions clearly set it up in advance, pulling in hundreds of groups including trade unions, anti-racism campaigners, and Muslim representative bodies under the Together Alliance to stage the whole thing and bill it as the biggest. They timed it just weeks before key local elections and six months after Britain saw one of its largest-ever far-right demonstrations, all to flip the narrative, demonize real opposition, and keep the public distracted from what's actually going on. This is how they maintain control while pretending it's grassroots.
